name: alerts-bell help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:alerts-bell. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Open alerts
entries.text: Opens alerts. Part of Alerts bell.

entries.title: Show the alerts bell on the banner
entries.text: Where you set “Show the alerts bell on the banner”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Alerts bell.

entries.title: Alerts bell
entries.text: Shows the “Alerts bell” part of this screen. Part of Alerts bell.

entries.title: Notification history
entries.text: Every alert the console delivered to each device (the phone, a browser) with when it arrived, was read and was tapped. Mark read and Dismiss are the alerts' own actions, so Claude (alerts tools), the CLI and voice do the same.
